chương trình thạc sĩ kiến trúc tại văn l: The Master of Architecture program at Van Lang develops specialized and interdisciplinary knowledge, connecting architectural theory with design, consulting and management activities. Students improve their ability to analyze contexts, form ideas and solve architectural problems in professional practice.
định hướng ứng dụng được thể hiện qua đồ: The applied track is demonstrated through advanced design projects, urban morphology, architectural tours and criticism, project management, internships and capstone projects. Contents on sustainable design, heritage conservation and BIM add perspective to the solution development process.
bảy nhóm học phần tự chọn mở rộng sang c: Seven groups of elective modules extend to landscape, urban design, residential environment, green building, new technology and materials. Students choose one module in each group to accumulate 14 elective credits.
định hướng ứng dụng. kết nối thiết kế vớ: Applied track. Connecting design with practice.

chương trình đào tạo theo định hướng nào: What orientation is the academic program and how long does it take?
thạc sĩ kiến trúc được đào tạo theo định: Master of Architecture is applied training, 60 credits, standard duration of 18 months. Class schedules are arranged on weekday evenings and/or Saturdays and Sundays according to each semester's schedule. The official timetable is announced by the University.
tốt nghiệp ngành kiến trúc có cần học bổ: Do Architecture Graduates Need Bridging Courses?
người tốt nghiệp ngành kiến trúc có chươ: Architecture graduates whose undergraduate curriculum comprised at least 150 credits are exempt from bridging courses. Other listed fields and programs are reviewed to determine requirements of up to 9 bridging credits. For fields not listed, the relevant Faculty submits its assessment and recommendation to the University.
chương trình có 7 nhóm tự chọn, mỗi nhóm: The program has 7 elective groups, each group includes 2 modules. Registration and class opening are carried out according to the Faculty's academic plan.
phần thực tập và đề án tốt nghiệp gồm ba: How many credits does the internship and capstone project include?
khối phát triển dự án, thực tập và đề cư: Project development, internship and proposal includes 15 credits: Architectural project management and development 6 credits, Internship 1 is 6 credits and Internship 2 is 3 credits. The capstone project has 9 credits. These modules are part of the total 60 credits of the program.
yêu cầu ngoại ngữ đầu vào và đầu ra như: What Are the Foreign Language Requirements for Admission and Graduation?

Before being recognized for graduation, students need to meet foreign language graduation requirements equivalent to Level 4/6 or higher according to regulations.
